data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a profit of GBP 7,833,000 (2018: GBP 1,570,000), of which a loss of GBP 5,556,000 is attributable to the 2019 year of account, a profit of GBP 14,806,000 is attributable to the 2018 year of account and a loss of GBP 1,417,000 is attributable to the 2017 and prior years of account.
data.standardized_narrative: Probitas Syndicate 1492 reports a net prior-year release of GBP 13.389m for the year ended 31 December 2019 (driven by a GBP 14.806m profit on the 2018 year of account offset by a GBP 1.417m loss on 2017 & prior). Opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2018 column) was GBP 95.568m. The release is driven primarily by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries, with the calendar year described as benign and limited major loss activity; reserve assumptions for classes other than Property were maintained at planned levels.
raw_causal_phrases: The calendar year has been benign with minimal major loss activity.

The 2019 yoa account has developed favourably to date with Property Gross Earned Loss ratio at 45% and for all other classes, loss reserve assumptions have been held at planned levels following consideration of the experience in the year.
Earned reserves are assessed to reflect the experience to date.
The 2017 & prior years of account is closing with a collectable loss of GBP 23,857,000 (2016 & prior years of account - GBP 10,447,000).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2018 comparative column). Prior-year development derived from year-of-account result breakdown in Managing Agent's report (2018 YOA profit GBP 14.806m and 2017 & prior loss GBP 1.417m => net prior-year release GBP 13.389m). No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was located; gross claims development triangle is present and was cross-checked but primary prior-year figure used is the YOA breakdown. LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified in the report; amounts per LOB for movements are therefore null. Claims development triangle is provided in GBP 000s; other monetary fields in this JSON are converted to millions as required.
